title: Borrow Through Match
goal: Match on an Option reference without moving ownership.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 1 Afternoon: Match Ergonomics

hints: Pass the reference directly to match to enable match ergonomics.
Explicit mut bindings in pattern arms bypass ref mode and try to move the value.
explanation: Matching on `opt` directly enables match ergonomics, binding `s` as `&String` without moving ownership. Dereferencing with `*opt` tries to move the `String` out of a reference, triggering `E0507`. Writing `Some(mut s)` disables reference binding mode and also triggers `E0507`.
